originality.rationale: Cereceda–van den Heuvel–Johnson 2005 Property 7 proves H4 is k-mixing for k>=4, so connectedness is prior. It does not determine the exact two graph diameters, self-centered eccentricity for every named coloring, or all pair-distance histograms. Resultary searches for the exact Moser spindle metric found this record and metric studies of different graphs (Petersen, Wagner, Grötzsch), not a previous same-object table. This is a natural finite exact refinement, not a claim of new connectivity or a general family theorem.
